_readme: Edit this file to change meats, flavours, boxes, sizes and prices. The server uses it to check and price every preorder, and the website reads it too.
_prices: Prices live on each meat below (price of one pack, by size) and on each box.

custom._note: Custom pack sizes are switched off for now. Set enabled to true to bring back the size picker; a custom pack is priced from the 100 g price (e.g. 250 g beef = 2.5 x 130).

paymentNote: No payment online. You pay when Ed delivers your order.

flavours.name: Texas BBQ
flavours.notes: Brown sugar, smoke and a peppery rub, slow dried onto premium beef.

flavours.name: Garlic Teriyaki
flavours.notes: Soy and roasted garlic in a sticky teriyaki glaze. Deep and savoury, no heat.

flavours.name: Honey Sriracha
flavours.notes: Golden honey up front, then a sriracha kick that keeps building.

flavours.name: Texas BBQ

flavours.name: Garlic Teriyaki
flavours.notes: Tender chicken in a soy and garlic teriyaki glaze. Light, savoury, no heat.

flavours.name: Honey Sriracha

boxes.name: Taster box
boxes._note: grams = what the whole box weighs. Six 50 g packs, one of every flavour.
boxes.tagline: All six flavours in one box.
boxes.notes: A small pack of every flavour, beef and chicken. The easiest way to find your favourite.
